moments.title: Full Earth over the Moon
moments.blurb: New Moon on Earth means full Earth on the Moon: 2 degrees wide, lighting the regolith with earthshine.

moments.title: Blue sunset on Mars
moments.blurb: Fine dust scatters blue light toward the Sun after sunset. Earth shines as the evening star.

moments.title: Pale Blue Dot, 14 Feb 1990
moments.blurb: Voyager 1, about 40 AU out, looks back: Earth is a faint point barely 1.4 degrees from the Sun.

moments.title: Our Sun from Alpha Centauri
moments.blurb: From the nearest star system the Sun is a magnitude 0.5 star in Cassiopeia.

moments.title: Beside Betelgeuse
moments.blurb: A red supergiant wider than Mars's orbit, seen from 40 AU.

moments.title: Earth from JWST
moments.blurb: From the second Lagrange point, 1.5 million km out, Earth and Moon share the binocular field.
